g.text: Dark maritime ambient music loop for the day phase of a 1930s
cursed-island survival game. Slow low strings and cello drone in D
minor, a distant foghorn swell roughly every 20 seconds, faint sea
chorus and rope creaks, sparse felt piano with tape hiss. Muted
teal-and-brass palette mood: hopeful but never bright. 90-120
seconds, seamless loop, no melody hooks, no vocals, no drums.
Deliver 48 kHz WAV plus OGG; loopable.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
